using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Cluster.Tests
{
    public class MigrateSessionTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<MigrateSession>> _mockLogger;
        private readonly Mock<GarnetClient> _mockClient; // Assuming client type based on usage
        private readonly MigrateSession _session;

        public MigrateSessionTests()
        {
            _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<MigrateSession>>();
            _mockClient = new Mock<GarnetClient>();

            // Setup minimal dependencies for constructor - adjust based on actual constructor
            // This is a minimal setup to reach the target code paths
            _session = new MigrateSession(
                /* inject required dependencies here - simplified for test focus */
                logger: _mockLogger.Object,
                timeout: TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(100),
                cts: new CancellationTokenSource(),
                /* other required params */
            );
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_WhenOperationCanceled_LogsErrorWithTimeoutAndSlots()
        {
            // Arrange
            _mockClient.Setup(c => c.SetSlotRange(It.IsAny<byte[]>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<object>()))
                .Returns(new Mock<IAsyncResult>().Object); // Simplified

            // Setup to throw OperationCanceledException on WaitAsync
            var mockWaitable = new Mock<IWaitable>();
            mockWaitable.Setup(w => w.WaitAsync(It.IsAny<TimeSpan>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
                .Throws(new OperationCanceledException());

            _mockClient.Setup(c => c.SetSlotRange(It.IsAny<byte[]>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<object>()))
                .Returns(mockWaitable.Object);

            // Act
            var result = await _session.TrySetSlotRangesAsync(nodeid: "test-node", state: MigrateState.STABLE);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("SetSlotRange operation timed out or was cancelled after") && v.ToString().Contains("slots")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_WhenUnexpectedException_LogsErrorWithExceptionAndSlots()
        {
            // Arrange
            var exception = new InvalidOperationException("Test exception");
            _mockClient.Setup(c => c.SetSlotRange(It.IsAny<byte[]>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<object>()))
                .Returns(new Mock<IWaitable>().Object);
            
            var mockWaitable = new Mock<IWaitable>();
            mockWaitable.Setup(w => w.WaitAsync(It.IsAny<TimeSpan>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
                .Throws(exception);

            _mockClient.Setup(c => c.SetSlotRange(It.IsAny<byte[]>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<object>()))
                .Returns(mockWaitable.Object);

            // Act
            var result = await _session.TrySetSlotRangesAsync(nodeid: null, state: MigrateState.IMPORT);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("An error occurred during SetSlotRange for slots")),
                    It.Is<Exception>(ex => ex == exception),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TryRecoverFromFailureAsync_WhenTrySetSlotRangesAsyncFails_LogsErrorMessage()
        {
            // Arrange - make TrySetSlotRangesAsync return false to hit the log call
            // This requires making TrySetSlotRangesAsync virtual or using refactor tool if needed

            // Act
            var result = await _session.TryRecoverFromFailureAsync();

            // Assert - verify the specific error message was logged
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("MigrateSession.RecoverFromFailure failed to make slots STABLE")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
